metas.name: 1 · ★ 6.8 · 2001 · Bridget Jones's Diary
metas.description: Bridget Jones is determined to improve herself while she looks for love in a year in which she keeps a personal diary.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 6.0 · 2004 · Bridget Jones: The Edge of Reason
metas.description: After finding love, Bridget Jones questions if she really has everything she'd ever dreamed of having.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 6.4 · 2016 · Bridget Jones's Baby
metas.description: Bridget Jones' focus on her single and professional life is interrupted when she discovers she is pregnant, but is unsure of the identity of the father.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 6.5 · 2025 · Bridget Jones: Mad About the Boy
metas.description: After jumping back into the dating pool, single mother Bridget Jones finds herself caught between a younger man and her son's science teacher.
